answer: Standing should cost an aging trail copies cannot fake. Each applicant locks an opal escrow; its play-of-color is photographed under a fixed lamp as the bond's fingerprint. A copied file fails a live re-scan and the escrow is slashed. Vote weight stays zero until a public beacon reports that fingerprint re-checked after every layer of a shale of settlement receipts—each from a different counterparty clock, none backdatable. The beacon lights only when the last layer is final. Shared treasury origins slash the cluster, so fresh bonds burn capital and wait time without buying a vote.
